title: Q-KG-practical-solutions: give practical-solutions its self-maintained knowledge graph (KGRAPH-1)
body:
**Owner:** knowledge
**Trigger:** executor tick, driver order
**Done check:** cmd:python3 -m foundation kgraph --list shows `practical-solutions: live`
**Status:** open

Practical Solutions keeps a single-blob core/kgraph graph and core/connect leads in its own repository. Vendor seed/worker/src/knowledge.js (add it to its vendor map in doctrine/tenant-repos.json), write mappers for problems, solutions, agencies and sources, run runKg on its clock, serve /api/graph and a live /graph page, then mark it live in doctrine/knowledge-graph.json. Unlearn is the reference tenant (ultrastable/unlearn worker/graph.js).

Prediction: kg_nodes for tenant practical-solutions > 0 within 168 h.

size: M

**Closing probe:** cmd:python3 -m foundation kgraph --check, with practical-solutions live in doctrine/knowledge-graph.json.
